q: In which year was Sheffield United founded at Bramall Lane?
hint: Sheffield United Cricket Club set up a football branch at its ground in March 1889 to replace the gate money it had lost.

q: Sheffield United have played their home matches at the same ground since the club was formed. Which one?
hint: Bramall Lane was already a cricket ground when the football club was created there, and United have never had another home.

q: Which shirt design has been Sheffield United's first choice for most of the club's history?
hint: Red and white stripes with black shorts have been the Blades' colours almost from the beginning.

q: In which season did Sheffield United win the Football League First Division title?
hint: Ernest 'Nudger' Needham captained Sheffield United to the championship in 1897-98, the club's only top-flight title.

q: How many times did Sheffield United win the FA Cup before the Premier League was formed in 1992?
hint: United lifted the cup in 1899, 1902, 1915 and 1925, and have not reached a final since 1936.

q: Tony Currie left Sheffield United in 1976 after eight years at Bramall Lane. Which club signed him?
hint: Leeds paid £250,000 for Currie in 1976, a record fee for them at the time; he moved on to QPR three years later.

q: Which club's departure from Bramall Lane in 1887 led the ground's owners to start their own football team?
hint: Wednesday were tenants at Bramall Lane from 1881 to 1887 and walked out after a row over rent, costing the cricket club its biggest earner.

q: Bramall Lane staged the world's first football match played under floodlights. In which year?
hint: On 14 October 1878, four 30-foot wooden towers lit an exhibition match at Bramall Lane, eleven years before the football club existed.

q: Sheffield United won their first FA Cup in 1899, beating which club 4-1 in the final?
hint: Derby County led at half-time at Crystal Palace before United scored four, with Fred Priest among the scorers.

q: Sheffield United's 1902 FA Cup final went to a replay after a 1-1 draw. Who did they beat 2-1 to lift the trophy?
hint: Southampton were still a Southern League club, and both matches were played at Crystal Palace a week apart.

q: Sheffield United's 3-0 win over Chelsea in the 1915 FA Cup final is remembered by which nickname?
hint: Uniformed soldiers filled Old Trafford, and Lord Derby used the trophy presentation to urge more men to enlist.

q: What was the score when Sheffield United beat Cardiff City in the 1925 FA Cup final at Wembley?
hint: Fred Tunstall's goal after half an hour settled it, and United have not won the cup since.

q: Sheffield Wednesday's win over Sheffield United on Boxing Day 1979 is known as the 'Boxing Day Massacre'. What was the score?
hint: A crowd of 49,309 at Hillsborough saw Ian Mellor open the scoring from 25 yards in a 4-0 rout of the Third Division leaders.

q: Which player did Dave Bassett sign from Doncaster Rovers in 1988, going on to form a famous strike partnership with Tony Agana?
hint: Brian Deane cost £25,000 and his partnership with Agana carried United through back-to-back promotions.

q: Sheffield United went up in 1989-90 as Second Division runners-up, level on points with the champions. Which Yorkshire club finished above them on goal difference?
hint: Leeds and United both ended the season on 85 points; Leeds took the title on goal difference and both clubs went up.

q: Which forward holds Sheffield United's all-time club goalscoring record, with 201 goals?
hint: Harry Johnson scored his 201 goals across the 1920s, comfortably clear of Alan Woodward's 158.

q: After leaving Bramall Lane in 1978, Alan Woodward finished his career in the North American Soccer League with which club?
hint: Woodward scored more than 150 goals from the wing for United before joining Tulsa Roughnecks in 1979.

q: Sheffield United were relegated to the Fourth Division on the final day of the 1980-81 season after losing to which club?
hint: Don Givens' late penalty was saved by Ron Green, and Walsall stayed up at United's expense.

q: Sheffield United won the Fourth Division title at the first attempt in 1981-82. Who was their manager that season?
hint: Ian Porterfield, scorer of Sunderland's winner in the 1973 FA Cup final, took charge that June and Keith Edwards scored 35 goals.

q: Sheffield United still avoided relegation in 1990-91 despite going how many league games without a win at the start of the season?
hint: United had four points from their first 16 games, then won 13 of the last 22 to finish 13th in the First Division.
